name: Classic Beef Burger
description: Double beef, cheddar, lettuce, tomato, pickles, and house sauce on a toasted bun.

name: Smoky BBQ Burger
description: Two charred patties, melted cheese, and a smoky sauce on a sesame bun.

name: Crispy Chicken Wings
description: Glazed wings with a cool dip. Crispy edges, sticky centers, eight to a box.

name: Peri-Peri Chicken
description: Fried chicken with a bright peri-peri heat, served hot from the fryer.

name: Wing Bucket
description: A sharing bucket of crispy fried chicken for the table, or just for you.

name: Pepperoni Pizza (Large)
description: A large pie with a blistered crust, tomato sauce, and a heavy layer of cheese.

name: Margherita Pizza
description: Tomato, mozzarella, and herbs on a thin, charred crust.

name: Chicken Wrap
description: Grilled chicken, crunchy slaw, and sauce rolled in a warm tortilla.

name: Beef Wrap
description: Sliced beef, onions, and garlic sauce in a toasted wrap.

name: Loaded Fries
description: Crisp fries piled with cheese, herbs, and a salty finish.

name: Classic Fries
description: Straight-cut fries, salted and served in a basket.

name: Citrus Cooler
description: A cold citrus drink with ice, made to cut through anything fried.

name: Mango Smoothie
description: Blended mango, ice, and a little lime. Thick, cold, and sweet.

name: Chocolate Fudge Cake
description: A slice of dark chocolate cake with frosting, for after the burger.
